_doc: CAL-010 village almanac: one omen per day (Almanac.omen_for), picked by weight from `omens`. Fields: id, name (<= 30 chars), text (a string, or an array of strings picked by day; each <= 120 chars), weight (>= 1), boost {} with optional keys fishing_mult 1.0..1.3, gather_bonus 0..0.25 (chance of one extra herb unit), gift_favor 0..3 (extra favor on a liked/neutral gift), sell_mult 1.0..1.1, practice_mult 1.0..1.25. Empty boost = a plain day. Never touches qi, breakthroughs or combat.

omens.name: An ordinary day
omens.text: Nothing in the stars favors or spoils today's work.

omens.name: Neither good nor ill
omens.text: The almanac is silent: a day like any other.

omens.name: Good for fishing
omens.text: The water is calm and the fish are hungry.

omens.name: Good for gathering
omens.text: Herbs stand thick and bright on the hillsides.

omens.name: Good for gifts
omens.text: Hearts are open today; a gift is warmly received.

omens.name: Good for trade
omens.text: Buyers are generous when the wind sits in the east.

omens.name: Good for practice
omens.text: Hands and mind are quick; practice sinks in deeper.

omens.name: Fish rise to the bait
omens.text: Fish rise to the bait; the river god is in a good mood.

omens.name: Heavy morning dew
omens.text: Dew hangs on every leaf; the herb slope smells green and strong.

omens.name: Market-day wind
omens.text: Drovers sing out their prices and nobody haggles hard today.

omens.name: A day for kind words
omens.text: Even the headman smiles; small gifts are remembered all year.

omens.name: Steady hands
omens.text: The cicadas are quiet, the lamp burns straight; work goes smooth.

omens.name: Nets hang heavy
omens.text: Old Gui says the nets will hang heavy by dusk; he is seldom wrong.
